title: open-charts template fill data, version 1
description: Data for `open-charts fill template.pptx data.json`: values by slot name (text for {{name}} fields, a chart spec for a shape named chart:name) and, optionally, which template slides to output in which order, repeated per item. Limits enforced by validateFillData(): at most 2000 slides, 1000 items per `each`, 10000 characters per text.

style.description: Style for every chart: over a --style file, under each chart's own style. The template's theme colours always win.

slides.description: Output slides in order. Omitted: every template slide once, in template order. Template slides not listed are left out.

values.description: Values for this slide, over the data's values.

each.description: One copy of the slide per item, each item's values over the slide's.
